why: Expression cycle 3 (docs/v3/cycles/expression-3.md) logged `primitive` findings that need no new export or contract change: shipped components cost points in builds that used them as documented. Reference-line and end labels still land on bars and dots: v3-expr-2-kit-fixes moved them off lines and other labels, not off bar and dot marks. 'Need 7h' sits on n12's tallest bar in its restless fixture, 'US$200/day' on c12's bars in its over fixture, 'typical' and 'stuck' on n02's dots, and c13's end label touches the line peak in its quiet fixture (P2 expression-3.38, .92; P3 .41, .58; n02's .74 is filed under v3-expr-3-contract, whose tick step is its larger part). The chart's own text follows the browser locale while `useFormat` follows the provider: on a German host the axis read '18. Okt.', the engine tooltip 'Mo., 19. Okt. 2026' and the y ticks '0,8' beside English page text and a table that prints '0.9' (n02, n12, c13, c12). Rows that spread `focus.item(i)` are dimmed by the kit so far that their text drops below contrast in dark (c10, c13), and a focused row below a list's fold never scrolls into view, so the link is invisible (c13; c09 in cycle 2). Dots at the plot floor are cut in half (n02). Two defects showed only once the playground generated the chart box classes in round 1: the legend row of a kind is clipped at the bottom of the fixed chart box (c11, c12), and a diverging bar chart in the default box at 390 px clips its negative half and its x axis (c13). The trial playground itself hid part of this: its `index.css` lists Tailwind `@source` folders by hand and missed `packages/basalt-ui/src/charts`, so no `ChartCard` box-height class was generated and every loading, empty and error card collapsed (15 round-0 points, class `harness`). With the line added, the quality matrix reports focus outlines clipped on `StatCard` sparklines and on the rail toggle (`/cards`, `/cycle/dogfood`, `/overview`), which a consumer that gets the chart classes from the Vite plugin already has; so the line could not land with the cycle and lands here with those fixes.
what: Fixes inside existing v3 chart and card components: label collisions against bar and dot marks, one locale for every piece of chart text, a dim floor and scroll-into-view for linked rows, unclipped edge dots, the legend inside the chart box, the negative half of a diverging chart at narrow width. No new export, no contract.ts change; the playground scans the charts folder, and the focus outlines that exposes are no longer clipped.
owns: packages/basalt-ui/src/charts/parts/**, src/charts/core/** (label placement, ticks, tooltip formatting, plot clipping)
packages/basalt-ui/src/charts/focus.tsx (the dim and the scroll of a focused item, no API change)
packages/basalt-ui/src/charts/date-tick-format.ts and the chart's use of the provider locale
packages/basalt-ui/src/cards/stat-card*.tsx and src/shell/parts/** where a focus outline is clipped
must_not_touch: apps/playground/src/scenarios/expr/** (the trial builds stay as their builders left them)
change: (1) The collision pass for refLine, xRefLine, zone and series end labels also treats bar rects and dot marks as obstacles: a label that would overlap one flips side, moves to clear space inside the plot, or drops (n12, c12, n02, c13). (2) Axis ticks, the engine tooltip header and rows, and y tick numbers format through the provider's locale, the one `useFormat` uses, never the browser default, so one page never mixes two locales (n02, n12, c13, c12). (3) The kit's dim of a `focus.item` row keeps its text at or above the contrast the token table guarantees for muted ink, in both schemes (c10, c13); a focused item inside a scroll region scrolls into view with `block: 'nearest'` and no motion under reduced motion (c13, cycle 2 c09). (4) Dot marks whose centre sits on the plot's edge draw whole: the plot clip leaves room for the mark radius (n02). (5) A kind's legend row sits inside the chart box's height budget and is never clipped by the box (c11, c12). (6) The default `auto` box at a 390 px container is 160 px tall, and the plot, the x axis and the legend of a kind do not fit in it: n12 and c11 lost their x axis and legend there, and c13's diverging bars lost their negative half. The box floor grows to what a kind's axis and legend need, or the kind drops the legend row first, so every kind at 390 px shows its x axis and every bar, negative ones included (n12, c11, c13). (7) Add `@source '../../../packages/basalt-ui/src/charts';` to apps/playground/src/index.css and fix the focus outlines the quality matrix then reports clipped: the sparkline of a `StatCard` (`div[stat-chart]>div[sparkline]`) and the rail toggle (`span[shell-rail-toggle]>button`), so `/cards`, `/cycle/dogfood` and `/overview` pass the matrix with no new waiver (cycle 3 § Harness). Each fix gets a layout test at 1800 and 390 px, light and dark where colour is in play. For each `// cycle-expression-3:` workaround in apps/playground/src/scenarios/expr that a fix covers, the PR names it; the trial files are not edited.
proof: make check; layout tests per fix.
acceptance: A Bars chart with a refLine whose label would sit on the tallest bar renders the label clear of every bar at 1800 and 390 px (layout test)
With the provider locale `en` and a browser locale `de-DE`, axis ticks, the tooltip and y ticks print English dates and a decimal point (test)
A dimmed `focus.item` row's text meets the muted-ink contrast in light and dark (test), and a focused row below the fold of its scroll region is scrolled into view (layout test)
A dot at the plot floor renders as a full circle (layout test)
A Bars chart with a legend in the auto box shows its legend row unclipped at 1800 and 390 px (layout test)
At a 390 px container a Bars chart with a legend, and one with negative values, show every bar and the x axis inside the default box (layout test)

apps/playground/src/index.css scans packages/basalt-ui/src/charts, a ChartCard keeps its loaded height in loading, empty and error in the playground, and the full quality matrix passes with no new waiver
out_of_scope: Anything that adds a prop, an option or an export (v3-expr-3-contract); the trial builds; the rubric.
